metadata.title: When you pretend that 1 lucky kill means you carried the whole VALORANT match
metadata.description:
Accidental shot of the century? Yep, that was me.
Pretending my aim just showed up for 1 kill.
This kill definitely wasn’t planned but here we are.

Click if your luck once made you feel like a pro!
